scope.basis: 248 entries from the UN M49 country-or-area list, plus Kosovo and Taiwan as supplementary research jurisdictions from its Q&A. Inclusion is research coverage, not a sovereignty classification.
scope.exclusion_rule: Only country rows already on the adoption page are excluded from this EN discovery round. Existing monitoring/sanctions/enforcement records alone do not exclude a country. Do not infer country-specific adoption from EU membership.

inventory_source.method: Official page read and downloaded; country names/codes extracted from English HTML table. Supplementary entries added explicitly from Q&A.
notes: Names are retained as published; aliases connect repository names such as Turkey and United Kingdom.
Null ISO codes for supplementary entries mean not taken from the source table, not a claim that no other identifier exists.

storage_rules.no_explicit_en_connection: Keep research in this shared index entry. Pending is not a negative finding; no_reference_found_in_checked_sources requires an actual bounded search log.
storage_rules.explicit_en_connection: Create or reuse the canonical country JSON, record source-supported connection and link it here. A draft/reference/translation is an explicit connection but not national adoption. Add registry/adoption-domain metadata under existing contracts; do not create a duplicate country file.
storage_rules.promotion: Transfer shared research history to the canonical record with stable provenance and references, then set research to null here. Keep only the pointer and administrative status in this index. Resolve schema support explicitly; never drop law findings during transfer.
storage_rules.legal_findings: Capture official law title, jurisdiction, type, source URL, relevant provisions, scope, dates with event meaning, status and uncertainty. Preserve distinctions between enacted/in-force/proposed and between legal obligations and voluntary standards.
storage_rules.existing_other_domains: Preserve existing_repository_record without treating it as EN evidence. This inventory creates no country file solely for law-only findings.

research_contract.budget: 30 minutes per run; 10 minutes per jurisdiction; at most two attempts per failing URL and two targeted follow-up searches per unresolved question. Log actual timing.
